build_resnet_selective_kernel_model: build a ResNet-SK trunk model with selective kernel convolutions for ViSSL feature extraction
create_selective_kernel_layer: create a selective kernel layer that adaptively weights two feature maps using softmax gating
create_bottleneck_block: create a ResNet bottleneck block with optional selective kernel convolutions and projection shortcut
create_stem_layer: create a stem layer that processes 3-channel input with selective kernel or standard convolutions
create_blocks_stage: create a stage of bottleneck blocks for a ResNet-SK feature extraction stage with configurable depth
